summary: Comprehensive Vitest unit testing for AI Provider, SCM, Configuration, and Command layers with shared test infrastructure
approach: Build shared test infrastructure first (mock factories, fixtures, helpers), then add module-specific tests in priority order: P0 commit generation + SCM (parallelizable), P1 config/settings, P2 AI provider + services (parallelizable). Each task produces independently testable output with measurable acceptance criteria.
estimated_time: 26-36 days total (P0: 15-20 days, P1: 5-7 days, P2: 6-9 days)
